Let me work through this.

Employee: Mary Lee (E015), contractor Analyst with basic security training. Requests admin access to Source Code.

Policy:
- contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.
- Mary has basic training, so max = read.
- Requested admin > max read. Grant maximum = read.
- Also never grant more than requested.

So decision: read.

Let me submit.
